_comment: Edit these to tune the gate. Every value is recorded in each result JSON so a run is reproducible.
_sharpness_note: Laplacian variance tracks RESOLUTION, not blur: median 1489 on the <700 px silhouettes vs 74 on the 3472 px phone photos, so as a hard check it failed every sharp phone photo. Recorded for information; the per-line edge-width check is the real blur test.
_text_box_note: an OCR detection covering more than this fraction of the product is a logo or graphic, not a text line (img48: one 845 px 'line' over the whole box). It is kept in the JSON as 'ignored' but does not count.
_product_note: a product under 200 px cannot carry readable text at all -> hard fail. 200-500 px is only a warning: img1 (450) and img3 (345) read fine, the text checks decide.
_text_rule_note: a text line is WEAK only when at least 2 of {too small, low OCR confidence, smeared edges} hold. Each signal alone has a benign cause: small but read confidently with crisp edges = fine (img5 'with'); low confidence but large and crisp = stylised/curved font (img23 'QUALITY GUARANTEED'); smeared but read confidently = soft design. Two together means image quality.
_edge_note: a line whose box reaches the alpha boundary is partial or belongs to a neighbouring pack (img1 'AE' = flipped SALTED of the pack above, img3 'COUa' = flipped GOYA). Enhancement cannot help partial text; recorded under ignored_detections.
_fragment_note: a SINGLE weak line of 3 characters or fewer is not enough evidence on its own (logo letters, kosher marks, a flipped sliver of the pack behind: img1 'AE', img9 'OD'). Two or more weak lines, or one weak line of 4+ characters, still fail.
